context: Prefer a second tsconfig (e.g. results-explorer/tsconfig.e2e.json) covering e2e/ with the Playwright types, and a typecheck script that runs both, over widening the main include (which would pull Playwright types into the app build). Wire it into whatever the browser CI job already runs so it fails before Playwright starts.
description: results-explorer/tsconfig.json line 29 sets include to ["src", "vite.config.ts"], so nothing under results-explorer/e2e/ is ever typechecked: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) does not see it, and vitest does not compile it either. Playwright specs and the shared e2e/support/fixtures.ts therefore compile by inspection only. This is not theoretical — during the cold-snapshot work (#1368) a fixture edit passed npm run typecheck while being wrong, and only a runtime Playwright failure caught it; a separate fake-connection edit had a genuine type error (TS2559) that surfaced only because that file happened to live under src/. The e2e harness is the blocking Chromium gate's own code, so a type error there costs a full ~3-minute CI round-trip to discover.
